services.desc: Have fun exploring Capitol Park this summer and earn a Junior Ranger Badge!Children ages 7-12 years will enjoy hands-on activities while they learn about the plants and animals in this urban park. Download and print out our new self-guided Capitol Park Junior Ranger Adventure Guide and explore California’s biodiversity in your own local park! Pick up a physical copy of the Capitol Park Junior Ranger Adventure Guide at the State Capitol Museum or Leland Stanford Mansion State Historic Park Visitor’s Center. services.name: View Exhibit
services.desc: Past exhibits from the State Capitol Museum have highlighted the diversity of California while bridging the state’s past, present, and future. The full scope of California’s state symbols is as remarkable as the state itself. Over the last 150 years, Californians have selected for themselves various symbols - ranging from plant species to marine life, from songs to nicknames, from ghost towns to memorials - to represent what is most remarkable about their state. Finding a permanent home for the capital was crucial for Californians in order to solidify the state’s stability in the nation.
